headline: Bring Nest events and controls into Home Assistant
intro: Connect supported Google Nest thermostats, cameras, and doorbells through Google's Smart Device Management API. Setup requires a Google Cloud project, a Nest Device Access project with a current US$5 registration fee, and a consumer Google account; Google Workspace accounts are not supported.
highlights: Control supported Nest thermostats and use their temperature, humidity, and fan sensors
Build automations from camera motion, person, sound, or doorbell events when the model supports them
Use camera streams and event snapshots or clips according to each device's capabilities; WebRTC cameras do not support camera recording actions
